SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.P.O. Headquarters
REPORT
File No. SPECIAL POLICE REGISTRY 7549
Date. Dec. 21, 19 37.

Subject Re Request From Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters for Copies of
Documents in Communist Case

Made by and Forwarded by Inspector Nakamura

Sir,
A representative of the Special Branch of the local
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters called at my office yesterday
and requested copies of documents in a communist case forming
the subject of a raid conducted by the S.M.P. some time
January this year at the Zaoshan Primary School (紹香小学),
Robison Road, when two Chinese were believed to have been taken
into custody.

The officer informed me that the Gendarmerie Headquarters
is now conducting enquiries in a case which has some connection
with the above-mentioned case and the loan or reference to the
documents in possession of the S.M.P., the Japanese military
authorities believe, would greatly facilitate their investigation.

Your obedient servant,
Inspector.

DC (J)
File hunt Form 8
return
mB
23 DEC 1937
D.C. (by B.)
I request that necessary
assistance be given.
Mr. J. Uyehara,
D. C. (Japanese).

特别巡捕房总部
报告
档案号：特别警察登记册 7549
日期：1937年12月21日。

事由：关于日本宪兵队总部请求提供共产党案件文件副本的事宜

由中村巡官制作并转呈

先生，
本地日本宪兵队总部特高课的一名代表昨日造访我的办公室，请求提供一份共产党案件的文件副本。该案件是今年一月某时，警务处在罗便臣道（Robison Road）绍香小学（註：原文为 Zaoshan Primary School (紹香小学)，此处依原文括号内汉字译出，但结合后文应为“造芳”或类似音译，此处暂按原文括号内汉字处理，若后文有冲突再调整，后文确认为造芳/绍芳）进行搜查行动的主题，当时据信有两名中国人被拘留。

该官员告知我，宪兵队总部目前正在调查一起与上述案件有关联的案件，日本军方当局认为，借阅或参考警务处持有的文件将极大地便利他们的调查工作。

您忠实的仆人，
巡官。

DC (J)
文件查找表 8
退回
mB
1937年12月23日
D.C. (由 B. 代签)
我请求给予必要的协助。
上原 J. 先生，
D. C. (日本人)。

（左侧批注：Di 1937年12月23日）

Accused. Teui Kong Yong ( ) a . teacher.

Charge Application for writ of detention, vide arts 76 & 101, of the C.C.P.R.C.
Application is hereby made before the ... Court for the detention of the above named person who was arrested at 11.15 a.m. on 2/10/36 at 1407 Mih Yih Li, Robison Rd., in ... Court Prison Cor ... being wanted by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Com ... rs on suspicion of being a communist.

IN THE SHANGHAI SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT

Mr. ... appeared for the S.M. Council.
(At the opening session, Judge Hsiao sat alone at the Court).

Proceedings. Mr. Lum:- The accused is wanted by the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commanders on suspicion of being a communist. Accused is the 4th person mentioned on the arrest warrant as an unknown male Chinese. At 11 a.m. on 2-10-36, at the request of a representative of the said Garrison Commanders, members of the Special Branch and Pootoo Rd Station proceeded to the Tau Foong Primary School at 1407 Mih Yih Li, Robison Rd, where the accused was arrested. The other three persons stated on the warrant were alleged to have left Shanghai and could not be located. No literature of revolutionary nature was seized. Accused denied being a communist but was implicated by another communist now in custody of the Chinese authorities.

Sha Eng Pei:- I am representing the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commanders to ask for the handing over of the accused. He was arrested at about 11 a.m. yesterday in the Tau Foong Primary School at 1407 Mih Yih Li, Robison Rd. He was implicated by one named Yang Tsoong Ming already arrested as being a communist. I request that he be handed over to us immediately.

D.S. Crossley then commenced to give evidence, but as

诉讼过程。林先生（Mr. Lum）:- 被告因被怀疑为共产党分子，正被吴淞-上海卫戍司令部通缉。被告是逮捕令上列出的第四人，身份为不明男性华人。1936年10月2日上午11点，应上述卫戍司令部代表的请求，特高课成员和普陀路警局警员前往罗便臣道集益里1407号的陶丰小学（Tau Foong Primary School），在那里逮捕了被告。逮捕令上提到的其他三人据称已离开上海，无法找到。未查获任何具有革命性质的文献。被告否认自己是共产党分子，但被另一名目前由中国当局羁押的共产党分子牵连。

                Judge Yoch to accused:-
Q.  Are you known to the prisoner Yang Tsoong Ming?
A.  Yes, he was formerly employed as a teacher in the same school
with me, but was later dismissed.
Q.  Is there one named Tsu Shien Vung in your school?
A.  Yes.
Q.  Who is the principal?
A.  One named Sung Yun Loong.
Q.  Where are they?
A.  Tsu has gone to Ping □□, and Sung to Hangchow.
Q.  Are there any other teachers in the school?
A.  Yes, one named Hen and two female teachers.
        Shu Bang Fei then re-outlined his evidence to Judge
Yoch and said that accused was implicated by Yang as a member of
the communist party, Western Shanghai Division.
Q.  Do you know if accused is the man Tsu Shien Vung wanted on
the warrant?
A.  He is not Tsu Shien Vung. He is the 4th person stated as
unknown on the warrant.
        Mr. Kum:- The prisoner Yang is in Court to-day.
        Yang Tsoong Ming:- I am 31 years, native of Kwangtung.
I reside at Lah Loh Poo, French Concession.
Q.  Is Tsu Shien Vung a member of the communist party?
A.  Yes.
Q.  Is accused the man Tsu Shien Vung implicated by you?

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Assistance to Chinese Authorities.
At 11 A.M. on 2.10.36., D.S. Pitts and C.D.C.281 attached to Special Branch (Political), together with Inspector Hsu Saung Fee of the Soongwu Military Authorities, came to this station in possession of Arrest Warrant No.423 and Search Warrant No.425, both issued by Judge Dzau of the S.S.D.Court, at the request of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commanders Headquarters. The former being issued for the arrest of four persons namely:- Sung Nyoon Ong (沈元洪), Tsu Hai Vung (朱希文), Sung Keu (沈某) and one name unknown, residing at the Zau Faung (造芳) Primary School, No.1407 Zih Yih Li, Robison Road, for being communists. The latter warrant authorized the Police to search the school premises for communist literature.
The undersigned and C.D.D. 317 rendered assistance and in company with aforementioned officers proceeded to the school, where enquiries revealed that the 1st and 2nd named persons on the Arrest Warrant had left Shanghai prior to the Mid-Autumn Fastival, for Hangchow and Pingwoo respectively, whilst the 3rd named person was unknown. One Tsui Kong Yang (朱孔陽), present at the time of the raid, was recognised by Inspector Hsu Saung Fee, who stated that this man filled the description of the 4th unknown man mentioned on warrant. A search made of the premises failed to reveal any literature
（左侧手写批注：included in D.R. as she left 3/10.）

At the request of the Soongwa representative, Tsui Kong Yang was brought to the station and questioned, and stated that he came to Shanghai during February this year from his native place, Changchow, and succeeded in obtaining a position as teacher in the Zau Faung Primary School, where he also resides. He strenuously denied he is a communist or that he is in any way connected with any political party, however, he has been detained and will appear before the S.S.D.Court on the a.m. of 3.10.36. when a Writ of Detention will be applied for, it being understood that a representative of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's Headquarters will also be present to apply for his extradition.

Tsui Kong Yang(朱孔陽), 34, married,
Changchow, Kiangsu. D.S. Pitts.
Pootoo Rd.Stn. 2.10.36. Clerk Z.O. Zung.

I was educated at a training institute for teachers in
my native place and after graduating, acted as a teacher in
a primary school there until February, this year, when I came
to Shanghai in the hope of getting a better job, as it was
always difficult to get my pay in Changchow owing to financial
difficulties.
I was successful in obtaining a position as a teacher
in the Zau Faung(紹芳 )Primary School, 1407 Zih Yih Li,
(集益里), Robison Road, at a salary of $20. per month. I
have also been residing on these premises since my appointment.
I am not a communist or a member of any political party
and since I am a comparative stranger to Shanghai and have no
friends, it is ridiculous to assert that I am in any way
connected with any anti-Government organisation or clique.

Tsui Kong Yang.
pages.zh:
朱孔阳 (Tsui Kong Yang)，34岁，已婚，
江苏常州。D.S. Pitts。
普陀路警局 1936年10月2日。书记员 Z.O. Zung。

我在家乡的师范培训机构接受教育，
毕业后，在当地一所小学担任教师，直到今年二月，由于常州财政困难，总是难以拿到薪水，我来到上海希望能找到一份更好的工作。
我成功在罗便臣道集益里1407号的绍芳（Zau Faung）小学获得了一份教师职位，月薪20美元。自受聘以来，我也一直居住在该处。
我不是共产党分子，也不是任何政党的成员，而且我对上海比较陌生，没有朋友，因此声称我与任何反政府组织或派系有任何关联是荒谬的。

朱孔阳。
